links.rationale: The fixed-edge singleton pair discharges exponentially many exact row obligations, providing a source-exact instance of the previously registered multiplexing warning.
Both failures show that a rich or large representation can be root-cheap unless a legal action budget proves that the quantity cannot be created or discharged for free.
A repair based only on dividing row mass by broad pair capacity risks becoming a fractional packing surrogate; C024 already warns that such relaxations can erase the required joint integrality.
